EventItemActionText:
The Board of Architectural Review met in regular session at 7:30 pm on Thursday, April 21, 2022, in the Vienna Town Hall at 127 Center St. S. Chairman Roy Baldwin, Vice-Chair Michael Cheselka, Patty Hanley, Paul Layer, and Linda van Doorn were present in Council Chambers. Zoning Administrator Andrea West, Planner Sharmaine Abaied, and Board Clerk Yaska Camacho Castillo were present in Council Chambers.

Mr. Baldwin called the meeting to order.  

Roll Call: Mr. Baldwin, Mr. Cheselka, Ms. Hanley, Ms. van Doorn, and Mr. Layer were present.

Request for approval of signs for Alma Salon, located at 512 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-744722-BAR, in the C-1 Local Commercial zoning district, filed by Jason Alexander, Vision Signs, Inc., project contact.
Jason Alexander- 45945 Trefoil Lane, Unit 184 Sterling, VA 20166 was present to represent the application.

Mr. Baldwin commented on the color, font, and location of words on the monument. Mr. Alexander stated the proposed documents were incorrect. He provided the board members with updated documents showing accurate designs/ details. The board members reviewed the documents, and  Ms. van Doorn inquired about the disconnect between the uploaded documents for the application and the ones provided in the meeting. Ms. Abaied replied that the applicant had provided the documents uploaded for the meeting.

Ms. Hanley wanted confirmation on the lumen level, color temperature, and color samples. She wanted to make sure the information wasn’t different from what was submitted the first time. Ms. Abaied stated the applicant was using the same colors as the Galaxy Dance Center project. 

Mr. Layer suggested the ampersand be reduced. Mr. Baldwin suggested the font of the beauty academy be the same size as the color salon and move color salon closer together. Mr. Alexander stated they will reduce the size of the ampersand to gain proper spacing. 

Mr. Cheselka made a motion to approve the signs for Alma Salon, located at 512 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-744722-BAR, in the C-1 Local Commercial zoning district with the condition that the ampersand is reduced by 15%, so the words “Color Salon” and “Beauty Academy” fit better.

Motion: Mr. Cheselka
Second: Ms. Van Doorn
Ayes: 5
Nays: 0
Motion passed
EventItemTitle: 512 Maple Ave W- Alma Beauty- Signs

EventItemActionText:
Request for approval of signs for Donutchew, located at 107 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-728558-BAR, in the C-2 General Commercial zoning district, filed by Myung Ho (Michael), Vivacity Global Biz., project contact.

Myung Ho Lee (Michael) – Vivacity Global Biz was present to represent the application. Mr. Lee gave a brief description of the meaning of Donutchew.

Ms. van Doorn wanted confirmation on the 3400k levels. The applicant confirmed it is not higher than 3500k. Ms. van Doorn asked staff members if the Board had previously accepted kelvin levels at 3500. Staff confirmed 3500k had been the Board's max kelvin levels approved.

Mr. Layer inquired about information on the front side donutchew graphic. He wanted clarification on the donutchew portion being illuminated and the white portion (scribed) being unilluminated. Additionally, he asked about colors for the graphic/ logo beside the blue and white. The applicant commented that any color could be available by printing. Ms. Hanley asked the applicant if the donut would be illuminated. The applicant replied yes.

Mr. Baldwin inquired about the shape of the donut graphic, and Ms. West clarified individual donuts are what shape the donut. He asked the staff if they had enough specificity on the color to ensure the sign complies with the application. Ms. Abaied replied yes, based on the rendering and colors provided in the box. 

Ms. Hanley asked if they had a dimension on the soffit where the sign would be on top. Ms. West replied they only had the dimension shown on the drawings. Ms. West asked the applicant if the full height of the sign fit in the soffit or if it would extend below the roofline. The applicant confirmed that it would extend below the roofline. 

Mr. Layer clarified they were referring to the fascia and that the dimension is needed to know if the sign will fit on the fascia.  Ms. Hanley suggested verifying the dimension. 

Mr. Layer made a motion to defer the request for approval of signs for Donutchew, located at 107 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-728558-BAR, in the C-2 General Commercial zoning district with the following suggestions:
• Resubmittal for the dimension of the fascia - (height and width) of the fascia needs to be included in the rendering.
• The box sign on the Center Street side of the building to have ¾ inch space above and below the box sign on the fascia. 
• ¾ space on fascia is required above and below the scribed portion of the channel letter sign (not just the illuminated part of the sign.)

Motion: Mr. Layer 
Second: Mr. Cheselka
Ayes: 5
Nays: 0
Motion passed

Request for approval of exterior modifications to an existing rooftop telecom facility to include: 9 antennas, 6 radios, 2 cabinets, 9 mounting pipes, mounting brackets, and a new 13’ custom screen wall around the equipment, for Sprint Telecommunications, located at 374 Maple Ave W, No. PF-555781-BAR, in the C-1A Special Commercial zoning district; filed by Katherine Blackwood of Network Building + Consulting.

Katherine Blackwood – 6095 Marshall Lee Dr. suit 300 Elkridge, MD 21075 was present representing the application. 

Ms. Blackwood stated they hadn’t made any changes, and the flagpole would be removed. She provided the board with the light gray color option for the board to consider.

Ms. Hanley inquired about the color sample. Ms. Blackwood replied the board suggested the charcoal gray color. The original color was black. The lighter gray is an alternative to the charcoal gray. She stated she submitted some photo simulations and book colors to compare.

Ms. van Doorn asked about the color of the antennas. Ms. Blackwood replied they have confirmed the antennas only come in the lighter gray color. 

Mr. Baldwin wanted clarification on Ms. Blackwood's comment on the charcoal gray color. She stated if the charcoal gray were selected, they would recommend painting the antennas to match so they won’t be visible. 

Mr. Baldwin inquired about the yellow/ orange arrows on the rendering pointing to the antennas. Ms. Blackwood stated the arrows point out where the antennas are located. He asked for clarification on where the lighter grey and darker gray will be used. 

Mr. Layer stated he believes manufactured colors are superior to site colors. He said that he is in favor of the manufactured light gray vs. painting the antennas. Mr. Baldwin agreed with Mr. Layer that lighter gray is a preferable color. 

Mr. Layer made a motion for approval of exterior modifications to an existing rooftop telecom facility to include: 9 antennas, 6 radios, 2 cabinets, 9 mounting pipes, mounting brackets, and a new 13’ custom screen wall around the equipment, for Sprint Telecommunications, located at 374 Maple Ave W, No. PF-555781-BAR, in the C-1A Special Commercial zoning district; filed by Katherine Blackwood of Network Building + Consulting with the following conditions:

• Lighter color 
• Antennas are as provided by manufacture prefinished

Motion: Mr. Layer 
Second: Ms. Hanley
Ayes: 5
Nays: 0
Motion passed
EventItemTitle: 374 Maple Ave E- Sprint- Exterior Modification

EventItemActionText:
Request for approval of exterior modifications for 625 Marshall Rd SW, Docket No. PF-672504-BAR, in the RS-16 Single-Family Residential zoning district, filed by Josh Bono, Ground Effects  Landscape Construction, project contact.

Josh Bono - P.O Box 748 Warrenton, VA was present representing the application.

Mr. Baldwin asked the applicant if he had anything he wanted to say before the board started with his application. Mr. Bono stated they might have to temporarily place the chain link fence back due to a five (5) month delay on the proposed fence. 

Mr. Cheselka asked if the chain-link fence had already been removed, and the applicant replied no. He said they would have to remove it to complete their work and place it back until the proposed fence arrives.  

Mr. Baldwin wanted confirmation on the type of fence the applicant will use. Mr. Bono confirmed he would be using the same fence located on the other side of the building. Mr. Bladwin inquired about the pavers that will replace the sand. Mr. Bono stated there is a sand sports court that no one is using, so they will replace the sand with pavers so the area can be utilized better. 

Mr. Cheselka inquired for clarity about the wood fence being pressure treated. Mr. Bono confirmed it is pressure treated and 6 ft tall. 

Ms. van Doorn asked the applicant if he will use rot iron or powder-coated aluminum.  Mr. Bono confirmed that it is powder aluminum, and all the dimensions are identical. 

Mr. Cheselka made a motion for approval of exterior modifications for 625 Marshall Rd SW, Docket No. PF-672504-BAR, in the RS-16 Single-Family Residential zoning district, as presented.

Motion: Mr. Cheselka 
Second: Ms. Hanley
Ayes: 5
Nays: 0
Motion passed
EventItemTitle: 625 Marshall Rd SW- Vienna Aquatics- Exterior Modifications

EventItemActionText:
Request for approval of exterior modifications for The Maple Room, located at 377 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-6989644-BAR, in the C-1 Local Commercial zoning district, filed by John Gaston, Paramount Construction Services, LLC. Project contact.

Christo Sarantis – 21441 Pacific Boulevard Suite 115 Sterling, VA 20166 was present to represent the application. 
John Gaston –21441 Pacific Boulevard Suite 230  Sterling, VA 20166 was present to represent the application. 

Ms. van Doorn inquired about the paver samples the applicant was supposed to provide in the meeting. Mr. Sarantis replied they couldn’t get them in time; therefore, he provided the board with pictures. Ms. van Doorn commented on the dark base and accent pieces. Mr. Sarantis replied that is what the landscaping designer recommended. Ms. van Doorn moved on by asking about the materials for the paver; she asked if it was concrete. Mr. Sanrentis replied he wasn’t sure; it should be the typical paver materials. Mr. Layer stated the applicant's brochure should identify the material used for pavers. 

Ms. Hanley asked about the manufacturer. Board members and staff members looked for information on materials on the brochure provided. It appeared the applicants did not submit the entire brochure. Mr. Gaston commented on the color being ravens' color. Ms. Hanley commented Nicolak is the brand.
She asked the applicant what type of base is he using and how is he setting up the stones. Mr. Gaston replied they are going with what the manufacturer recommends. Ms. Hanley commented on the temperature of darker colors. They can get a little hotter than the light colors. 

Mr. Layer commented he didn’t see a site plan for the rendering on the pylon. Ms. Hanley asked if they had removed the pylon from the application. Mr. Gaston replied they decided to do it separately based on the last meeting. They will return for a signage package.

Mr. Layer stated he would have liked to see the site plan to understand the pattern of the pavers. He continued by saying concrete would be better than sand. Mr. Sarantis commented he would put 4-inch concrete, then the sand, followed by the pavers. Mr. Layer suggested putting temperature mesh and drilling holes for drainage as recommended.

Mr. Sarantis stated they would have seatings around the rock. They are no longer having a fountain. Instead, they will have lighting and nice landscaping around it. Mr. Layer asked if he would border it on the sides and put the grey in the middle. Mr. Sarantis confirmed it would be bordered around the rock as well.  He stated he wanted to use river rocks, board members discussed what size the river rocks should be, and they all agreed on the rocks measuring 2-3 inches on a gray tone. 

Mr. Cheselka was under the impression that the pavers would be light and the trims would be dark, so he asked for some clarification on the color of the pavers. Mr. Sarantis confirmed it would be dark pavers with light trims around the rock. Mr. Cheselka asked the applicant if there had been any changes since the last meeting. Mr. Sarantis confirmed that no changes had been made.

Mr. Baldwin inquired about the handicap provision (wrap in the back). He asked the applicant if he was able to follow up on Mr. Layer’s suggestion on how to go about configuring if necessary. Mr. Gaston replied he has to review the comments made by Fairfax to see if they mentioned the 50%.  If required, they will consider the board's suggestion to widen the double door on the back or extend the handicap ramp on the other service door. Mr. Layer stated they would have to come back for a change like that, to which Ms. West confirmed they would need the board's approval. Ms. Hanley asked if it would be a modification for this application, and Ms. West stated it would be a revision. 

Ms. Hanley made a motion for approval of exterior modifications for The Maple Room, located at 377 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-6989644-BAR, in the C-1 Local Commercial zoning district, with the following specifications:

• Updated Landscaping Plan to reflect the following:
o Plaza accent paver wrap around the rock to be lined with river rock at 2”-3” in gray tones and bordered in a lighter tone both inside and outside.
o The paver pattern (darker pavers with light trim around the rock)
o Recommended system to a concrete base with drain holes, temperature mesh, and sand bed, then pavers
• The accent Rock to be cleaned and set inside the river rocks to include Uplighting and future seating around the rock. 

Motion: Ms. Hanley 
Second: Mr. Layer 
Ayes: 5
Nays: 0
Motion Passed
EventItemTitle: 377 Maple Ave W- The Maple Room- Exterior Modification/ Signs

Request for approval of signs for Galaxy Dance Center, located at 512 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-706316-BAR, in the C-1 Local Commercial zoning district, filed by Jason Alexander, Vision Signs, Inc., project contact.

Jason Alexander- 45945 Trefoil Lane, Unit 184 Sterling, VA 20166 was present to represent the application.

Mr. Alexander stated the last time he was in front of the Board, he explained lux instead of kelvins. He said they reduced the kelvins to 3200 and lumens to 105. The owner requested the balance presented be 9 ft from either side and 4ft equal distance between each cabinet. The first two boxes will be Galaxy and Alma. Positions 2 and 3 will be balanced until tenants take spots 1 and 4. 

Ms. Hanley asked the staff if the blank signs were part of the application. Ms. Abaied clarified that Galaxy and Alma salon are two different applications, Alma being the next item on the agenda. The blank signs are just placeholders.

Mr. Baldwin asked if the Galaxy Dance Center was ok with their position on the rendering showing the proposed layout when all tenants take their spots. Mr. Alexander replied yes. Mr. Baldwin stated that it would be a nice balance. 

Mr. Cheselka inquired about the illumination being 3200k since Mr. Alexander's diffusion chart reflected 7000k. Mr. Alexander stated that was an error; it should’ve not been part of the presentation. Ms. van Doorn pointed out that the application shows 7000k and then is reduced to 1120k. Mr. Alexander stated he wasn’t sure why that information was there. Mr. Cheselka asked Mr. Alexander what numbers is he proposing to the board. Mr. Alexander confirmed he is proposing 3200k and 105 lumens. Ms. Hanley asked the applicant if he had any hard copy showing the numbers he was presenting to the board, to which he replied yes. 

Mr. Cheselka inquired about the color of the cabinet. He wanted clarity if it would be dark midnight blue or black. Mr. Alexander replied the cabinet is black. Ms. Hanley pointed out the panel is dark blue.

Ms. Abaied commented that the applicant did add the tenant panel (monument) sign to the application vs. last time when he did not have it as part of the application.   
 
Ms. Hanley made a motion to approve the signs for Galaxy Dance Center, located at 512 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-706316-BAR, in the C-1 Local Commercial zoning district with the clarification, that the documents that include the 3200k level and the 105-lumen level is what the Board is approving. Additionally, the signage positions are the four located on the hard copy.

Motion: Ms. Hanley 
Second: Mr. layer
Ayes: 5
Nays: 0
Motion passed
EventItemTitle: 512 Maple Ave W - Galaxy Dancer Center - New Sign
